```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(camcorder)
library(here)
library(showtext)
library(clipr)
library(geomtextpath)
library(ggpattern)
library(ggrepel)

setwd(here::here("2026/week-05-jan-2026-edible-plants"))

font_add(
  "retrosun",
  regular = "/Users/amnbh/Library/Fonts/RetroSun.otf",
  bold = "/Users/amnbh/Library/Fonts/RetroSun.otf"
)
font_add_google("Righteous", "righteous")
font_add_google("Space Mono", "spacemono")
font_add_google("Libre Franklin", "franklin")
showtext_auto()

gg_record(
  dir = here("output"),
  device = "png",
  width = 18,
  height = 18,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

tuesdata <- tt_load(2026, week = 05)
df <- tuesdata$edible_plants |>
  select(common_name, water, sunlight, nutrients) |>
  mutate(
    common_name = str_remove_all(common_name, "\\s*\\(.*?\\)") |>
      str_remove_all("/.*")
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 28

clean_df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sun_cat = case_when(
      sunlight %in% c("Partial shade", "partial shade") ~ "PART SHADE",
      sunlight %in%
        c(
          "Full sun/partial shade",
          "Full sun/partial shade/full shade",
          "full sun/partial shade/ full shade"
        ) ~ "PART SUN",
      TRUE ~ "FULL SUN"
    ),
    sun_cat = factor(sun_cat, levels = c("FULL SUN", "PART SUN", "PART SHADE")),
    water_cat = case_when(
      water %in% c("Very High", "very high") ~ "Very High",
      water %in% c("High", "high") ~ "High",
      water == "Medium" ~ "Medium",
      water == "Low" ~ "Low",
      water %in% c("Very Low", "Very low") ~ "Very Low",
      TRUE ~ "Medium"
    ),
    water_cat = factor(
      water_cat,
      levels = c("Very High", "High", "Medium", "Low", "Very Low")
    ),
    water_radius = case_when(
      water_cat == "Very High" ~ 1.0,
      water_cat == "High" ~ 1.8,
      water_cat == "Medium" ~ 2.8,
      water_cat == "Low" ~ 3.6,
      water_cat == "Very Low" ~ 4.3,
      TRUE ~ 2.8
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(common_name, sun_cat, water_cat, water_radius)

wedge_stats <- clean_df %>%
  count(sun_cat) %>%
  mutate(
    width = 120,
    start_deg = (as.integer(sun_cat) - 1) * 120,
    end_deg = start_deg + 120,
    radius_max = scales::rescale(n, to = c(2, 4.5))
  )

bg_ribbons <- wedge_stats %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    sun_cat = sun_cat,
    angle = seq(start_deg, end_deg, length.out = 100),
    radius_max = radius_max,
    wavy_radius = radius_max + sin(angle * 0.15) * 0.25 + rnorm(100, 0, 0.04)
  )

set.seed(453)
plot_data <- clean_df %>%
  left_join(wedge_stats, by = "sun_cat") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    angle_final = runif(1, start_deg + 2, end_deg - 2),
    radius_final = scales::rescale(
      water_radius,
      to = c(0.9, radius_max - 0.15),
      from = c(1.0, 4.3)
    ) +
      rnorm(1, 0, 0.08)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

labeled_plants <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(sun_cat, water_cat) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 3) %>%
  ungroup()

pond_data <- data.frame(
  angle = seq(0, 360, length.out = 200),
  radius = 0.2
)

grid_circles <- data.frame(radius = c(1.25, 2.08, 3, 4)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    radius = radius,
    angle = seq(0, 360, length.out = 100)
  )

grid_spokes <- data.frame(angle = seq(0, 240, 120))

center_star <- data.frame(
  angle = rep(seq(0, 240, 120), each = 2),
  radius = rep(c(0, 0.45), 3)
) %>%
  mutate(group = rep(1:3, each = 2))

water_arrow <- data.frame(
  angle = 240,
  y = seq(0.9, 4.5, length.out = 50)
)


p <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon_pattern(
    data = bg_ribbons,
    aes(
      x = angle,
      ymin = 0,
      ymax = wavy_radius,
      fill = sun_cat,
      pattern = sun_cat
    ),
    alpha = 0.85,
    pattern_alpha = 0.08,
    pattern_density = 0.08,
    pattern_spacing = 0.025,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = pond_data,
    aes(x = angle, y = radius),
    fill = "#6BA3C4",
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "#4A7B94",
    linewidth = 12.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "path",
    x = seq(0, 360, length.out = 200),
    y = 5,
    linewidth = 4,
    color = "#263922ff",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = grid_circles,
    aes(x = angle, y = radius, group = radius),
    color = "#3D4A36",
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = grid_spokes,
    aes(x = angle, xend = angle, y = 0.7, yend = 4),
    color = "#3D4A36",
    alpha = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = center_star,
    aes(x = angle, y = radius, group = group),
    color = "#473827ff",
    size = 0.5,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(x = angle_final, y = radius_final, color = water_cat),
    size = 2.2,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#2D5016",
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(angle = 240),
    aes(x = angle, xend = angle, y = 0.2, yend = 4.8),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed"),
    color = "#2e4858ff",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_textpath(
    data = water_arrow,
    aes(x = angle, y = y, label = "LOWER WATER NEEDS"),
    family = "spacemono",
    size = 5,
    color = "#2e4858ff",
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0.65,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = labeled_plants,
    aes(x = angle_final, y = radius_final, label = common_name),
    size = 5.8,
    color = "#1A2E10",
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "spacemono",
    max.overlaps = 20,
    min.segment.length = 0.1,
    segment.color = "#3D4A36",
    segment.size = 0.5,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    force = 2,
    bg.color = "#E8DCC4",
    bg.r = .15
  ) +
  geom_textpath(
    data = wedge_stats,
    aes(x = (start_deg + end_deg) / 2, y = 5.5, label = sun_cat),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 8,
    color = "#172915ff",
    family = "franklin",
    upright = TRUE,
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FULL SUN" = "#E8A848",
      "PART SUN" = "#D49B5C",
      "PART SHADE" = "#8FAA7E"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Very High" = "#1E5A8E",
      "High" = "#4A7B94",
      "Medium" = "#E8DCC4",
      "Low" = "#C8B89F",
      "Very Low" = "#A89A7E"
    )
  ) +
  scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c(
      "FULL SUN" = "none",
      "PART SUN" = "stripe",
      "PART SHADE" = "circle"
    )
  ) +
  coord_polar(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 4),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    oob = scales::oob_keep
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 360), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = str_wrap("Sunlight & Water Requirements for Edible Plants", 30),
    subtitle = "Plants grouped by sunlight needs. \nLarger distance from center indicates lower water requirements.",
    caption = "Source: The Edible Plant Database | Visualization: @aman.bh"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#E8DCC4",
      color = "#3D4A36",
      size = 4
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "atkinson",
      size = 40,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#1A2E10",
      lineheight = 0.5,
      margin = margin(-10, 0, 20, 0)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      family = "spacemono",
      size = 20,
      color = "#3D4A36",
      face = "bold",
      lineheight = 0.8,
      margin = margin(0, 0, 30, 0)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      family = "spacemono",
      size = 14,
      color = "#3D4A36",
      margin = margin(45, 0, -50, 0)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(50, 50, 80, 50),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p
```
